The '''''Collaborator''''', originally the '''''Hrosha-Gul''''' (''Price of Pain'' in the [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|Yuuzhan Vong]]) was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-stronha]] picket ship analog. It was rechristened the ''Collaborator'' by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] when it was captured for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. Solo, [[Tahiri Veila]], [[Jagged Fel]], and [[Arth Gxin]] made use of it during the [[Battle of Esfandia]].
